limitations: Planning intent only; this TestSpec is not executable code.
title: Submit a payment to a valid recipient
intent: Verify that a valid payment changes the expected account and transaction state.
preconditions: A synthetic sender and recipient are available.
test_data_requirements: A resettable synthetic account pair with sufficient balance.

expected_outcomes.description: The payment is recorded exactly once.
Sender and recipient account state reflects the payment.

evidence_requirements.description: Reference the resettable synthetic state before and after execution.
Provider trace availability has not been qualified.

cleanup_requirements: Restore the canonical synthetic seed after the run.
